_dr_note: CONTRACT ONLY — intended n8n workflow shape for the premium video identity validator + rendered-video quality judge. NOT deployed, NOT active. Credential references only, no values. These are PAID Gemini-vision calls that run downstream of generation, so they stay inactive until the founder authorizes a bounded run. The DB decision functions (fn_video_identity_validate_decision, fn_video_quality_judge_decision) are pure and already tested with zero spend; this workflow only supplies their structured inputs.
name: Strateloq - Video Identity + Quality Judge (CONTRACT, inactive)
description: Two related Gemini-vision roles. (1) IDENTITY VALIDATOR: given the authoritative Product Card image + a frame of the composited/seeded scene, returns {product_match 0..1, shape_match, color_match, logo_legible, severe_artifacts}; the DB turns that into IDENTITY_PASS/REVIEW/FAIL (IDENTITY_FAIL hard-blocks launch; a generated/seeded scene needs IDENTITY_PASS to be launch-safe; reference-motion is never auto-PASS). (2) QUALITY JUDGE: given the rendered 9:16 mp4 (sampled frames) + the quality_family + shot plan, returns per-dimension 0..1 scores; the DB computes a 0..100 score and a PASS/REVIEW/FAIL band vs the family benchmark.

nodes.name: Judge Webhook
nodes.notes: Body: {role:'IDENTITY'|'QUALITY', product_card_ref?, scene_frame_ref?, rendered_video_ref?, quality_family?, shot_plan?}.

nodes.name: Gemini Vision Assess

googlePalmApi.name: Gemini account (EXISTING; reference only — no key value stored here)

nodes.notes: IDENTITY role: prompt returns STRICT JSON {product_match, shape_match, color_match, logo_legible, severe_artifacts}. QUALITY role: prompt returns STRICT JSON of per-dimension 0..1 scores matching the family's dimensions (cinematic: hook_strength, motion_realism, product_clarity, pacing, premium_finish, story_coherence; ugc: hook_strength, authenticity, product_clarity, pacing, retention, story_coherence). Model id is indicative; confirm the current Gemini vision model at activation.

nodes.name: Return Structured Assessment
nodes.notes: Parse + validate the JSON, then return it to the caller edge function, which passes it to the DB decision function. The DB (not this workflow) makes the PASS/REVIEW/FAIL decision.
